name: @pipeworx/mcp-funcheap

tools.name: search_events
tools.description: Search SF Bay Area free & cheap events/deals from Funcheap. Filter by keyword, facet tags (e.g. "free", "live-music", "comedy", "art", "family-friendly", "food"), and a published-date window. Returns newest first by default. Use the `tags`/`categories` tools to discover facet slugs.

query.description: Full-text keyword search, e.g. "outdoor movie" or "jazz".

tags.description: Comma-separated tag slugs to require, e.g. "free,live-music". Discover via the tags tool.

after.description: Only posts published on/after this ISO date, e.g. "2026-06-19" or "2026-06-19T00:00:00".

before.description: Only posts published on/before this ISO date.

orderby.description: Sort order (default "date" = newest first; "relevance" requires query).

tools.name: event
tools.description: Get a single Funcheap event by numeric post id or slug, with full cleaned body text (date/venue/price details live in the text).

slug.description: Post slug from an event URL, e.g. "fantasia-1940-35mm-live-organ-concert-paramount-theatre-oakland".

tools.name: tags
tools.description: List Funcheap event facet tags (slug, name, count). These are the filterable facets like "free", "live-music", "comedy", neighborhoods. Sorted by usage.

query.description: Optional search to find matching tags, e.g. "music".

tools.name: categories
tools.description: List Funcheap categories (slug, name, count) — broader groupings like neighborhoods, "fairs-festivals", "kids-families". Sorted by usage.

query.description: Optional search to find matching categories.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-funcheap forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the funcheap pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
